events.verdict: Sabonis (SAC) makes contact with the loose ball and any ensuing contact with Westbrook (DEN) is incidental.
Sabonis (SAC) reaches in and the contact with Jokic's (DEN) side is marginal.
Murray (DEN) moves alongside of Fox (SAC) as he attempts to get open to receive the throw-in and any contact that occurs is marginal.
Murray (DEN) obtains a legal defensive position in front of Fox (SAC), who drifts forwards into him as part of his shooting motion.

Fox (SAC) initiates the marginal body contact with Murray (DEN), who stops short and Fox's momentum carries him forwards. Fox is not dislodged from his defensive position by any illegal contact from Murray.
Westbrook (DEN) swipes down to contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with DeRozan's (SAC) arm.
Sabonis (SAC) briefly has a hand on Jokic's (DEN) arm as he deflects the loose ball.
